standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness of R -> S and of the localizations R_{f_i}, and commutation of kernels, cokernels and colimits with tensor products
standard_prerequisites.use: Is the single input that makes the componentwise construction of kernels and cokernels valid and that gives exactness and colimit commutation.

core_obligations: Describe a morphism (varphi', varphi_i) between two gluing objects and observe that its kernel and cokernel exist objectwise, given by (Ker(varphi'), Ker(varphi_i)) and (Coker(varphi'), Coker(varphi_i)) with the induced gluing maps (proof lines 24751-24760).

Justify the objectwise construction by the flatness of R -> S: kernels and cokernels commute with - tensor_R S, which is what makes the induced gluing data alpha_i, alpha_ij and beta_i, beta_ij correct (proof lines 24761-24762).
Deduce exactness of the functor Can from the R-flatness of the localizations R_{f_i} and of S (proof lines 24763-24764).
Deduce that Can commutes with arbitrary colimits from the fact that tensor products commute with colimits, completing the abelian-category claim (proof line 24764).
difficulty_reason: The lemma works with the gluing category Glue(R -> S, f_1, ..., f_t) attached to a flat ring map varphi : R -> S and the ideal I = (f_1, ..., f_t) of R, and asserts that this category is abelian and that the canonical functor Can is exact and preserves arbitrary colimits (source lines 24742-24748). The proof has to work with an object of that category, namely a tuple (M', M_i, alpha_i, alpha_ij) consisting of an S-module, R_{f_i}-modules and gluing data, and to show that kernels and cokernels can be formed componentwise as Ker(varphi') and Ker(varphi_i), respectively, with the gluing maps induced (proof lines 24751-24760). The key point is that this componentwise construction is legitimate precisely because R -> S is flat, so that taking kernels and cokernels commutes with - tensor_R S (proof lines 24761-24762); exactness is then reduced to the R-flatness of the localizations R_{f_i} and of S, and commutation with colimits to the corresponding property of tensor products (proof lines 24763-24764).
